events.verdict: Lively II (DAL) makes clean hand on ball contact dislodging the ball from Williamson's (NOP) possession.
Lively II (DAL) makes contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Lively II (DAL) is already in Queen's (NOP) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Williamson (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Marshall (DAL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.

Christie (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Williamson's (NOP) drive to the basket and absorbs the body contact. Marshall (DAL) then makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Williamson's possession.
Fears (NOP) is moving alongside Flagg's (DAL) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Fears (NOP) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends Flagg's (DAL) shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) loses control of the ball and Lively II (DAL) is able to gain possession.
Marshall (DAL) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends Williamson's (NOP) shot attempt.
Queen (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and cleanly dislodges it away from Marshall (DAL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Lively II (DAL) is late to establish a screening position, but the ensuing contact with Jones (NOP) is marginal.
Williamson (NOP) and Jones (NOP) both reach in as Flagg (DAL) splits the defenders and the contact is marginal.
Fears (NOP) commits a take foul on Christie (DAL).
Christie (DAL) and Murphy III (NOP) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Jones (NOP) establishes a wide screening position in Christie's (DAL) path and the ensuing contact is marginal.
